name: agent-board
description: Connects Claude Code to an agent progress board: the board's MCP server and a skill with the reporting rules

board_url.title: Board address
board_url.description: The https address of your board, ending before /mcp, with no trailing slash (https only: the token is sent with every request)

report_usage.title: Report token usage
report_usage.description: Send token counts to the board, read from Claude Code's own session records

read_plan_cap.title: Read the plan cap
read_plan_cap.description: Read Claude Code's own sign-in file to ask Anthropic for your plan's cap percentage, and send that percentage to the board. Off by default; works only while report_usage is on

environment.title: Environment label
environment.description: Where this Claude Code runs, shown on usage reports (for example desktop); leave empty to send none
